name: motor_shield
title: Liquid-cooled motor end shield: helical jacket, bearing tower, fan and shroud
description: The drive-end shield of a totally-enclosed electric motor, cast in aluminium, with a helical coolant passage cast into the wall of its bearing tower. It was chosen over the gearbox end-cap (scenes/end_cap.py) because every job it does lands on a harder corner of the modelling language than the last part did, and several of them land on the B-rep extraction's known failure classes on purpose:
